title: Lovable-built apps exposed passport data, 200K messages via weak RLS
summary: A security report found that apps built with Lovable exposed passport details and more than 200,000 private messages because their databases lacked sufficient Row-Level Security \(RLS\). Lovable&\#x27;s head of security confirmed that insufficient RLS was the root cause and said the platform automatically scans every app before publishing, offers a free deeper SAST scan, and lets users apply fixes or enable auto-fix. The report and discussion focus on whether underlying defaults, including Supabase&\#x27;s, make such exposure too easy for AI-generated apps.
